description: Returns the cmbs.news distress index: delinquency, special-servicing and matured-unpaid rates (balance-weighted, every public trust), this month's transfers in and out of special servicing, and rates by property type. Set view for one part, or for more: vintage, state, series (every month since December 2016) or seasoning. Open data under CC BY 4.0. Use it for market-wide rates and trends; use wire for the individual loans that changed this month.

view.description: Which part of the index to return. Leave out for the latest rates, this month's flows and rates by property type. vintage also has type by vintage; series is the monthly history; seasoning is how the age of the pool moves the rates

name: distress_index
title: CMBS distress index
